_note: Health lane watchlist (Morning brief, flag BRIEF_HEALTH_V1_MORNING, default OFF). Each condition lists case-insensitive regex 'terms' matched against a signal's title and description. Edit this file to change what is watched; no code change is needed. Prefer phrases over ambiguous single words. A signal flagged for safety (safety_relevance, fda_flagged) is always shown, whether or not it matches a term. 'exclude_title' phrases drop animal studies (matched against the title only).
